descriptions.sol32a_weapon_stock_800fcec8: Resolves the active worm when passed index -1, selects its current weapon for selector 60, rejects delayed or disabled weapons, then sums worm, team and alliance stock with -1 as the unlimited sentinel. Inline byte-index getters preserve the original nonnegative checks. All partial layouts describe the GC32 reference ABI only; no portable adaptation or runtime behavior is established.
